_comment: Expected served artifact CSP per sandbox mode. artifacts.rs (Rust, authoritative for served documents) and htmlSandbox.ts childCsp (the matching <meta>, and the srcdoc fallback) are both tested against this file, so the two cannot drift. NONCE stands for the document's own nonce: artifacts.rs draws a fresh one from the OS CSPRNG for every served document and puts it only into the slots the host's parts leave (the srcdoc fallback draws its own with crypto.getRandomValues). Offline, Images and HTTPS list no hash-source: under CSP3 a hash also allows an external script whose integrity attribute carries it (SRI repair, 2026-10-05). Canvas and Interactive list neither a hash nor a nonce, either of which would switch off 'unsafe-inline'. Only script-src changed in C2 and in the SRI repair; every network directive is as C1 left it.
offline: default-src 'none'; script-src 'nonce-NONCE'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'; media-src data: blob:; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
images: default-src 'none'; script-src 'nonce-NONCE'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob: https:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'; media-src data: blob:; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
https: default-src 'none'; script-src 'nonce-NONCE'; style-src 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src data: blob: https:; font-src data: https:; connect-src https:; media-src data: blob: https:; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
interactive: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline' https:; style-src 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src data: blob: https:; font-src data: https:; connect-src https:; media-src data: blob: https:; worker-src blob:; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
canvas: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data:; connect-src 'none'; media-src data: blob:; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
